Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Path to Win — MAP slate & close timeline

Hi Amelia,

Thanks again for the time today — really energized by the Greenline use case for clinical note summarization. I put together a first-pass 'Path to Win' MAP slate (Google Doc) and a one-slide close-sprint outline so we can align stakeholders and pick target dates. Links/attachments below.

Quick highlights (proposal):
- Pilot scope: anonymized 3-month note set, integration via S3 transfer + API for live inference.
- Success criteria: 92% API availability, median generation latency < 250ms P90 for 512-token prompts, precision on key-entity extraction >= 88%.
- Timeline (target): technical kickoff week of 5/26, pilot validation by 6/23, exec review 6/30, aim to close by 7/7 if procurement cleared.

Action items I proposed in the doc:
1) Technical kickoff: Greenline (Roberto, engineering) + Redwood (Hannah) — owner: Mateo — target 5/26
2) Procurement & legal checklist: send MSA + SOC2 links — owner: Amelia/Sanjay — target 5/21
3) Pilot data handoff + sandbox keys — owner: Hannah — target 5/28

Attachments: redwood_path-to-win_map_template_v1.gdoc (draft) and close-sprint-slate_v1.pptx.
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-map-draft
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789

Please review the success criteria section in particular — happy to tighten or loosen based on your clinical QA thresholds. If the timeline looks aggressive, tell us what would work for your execs and procurement.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Mateo — thanks, this is a clean starting point. A few quick notes after reading: 

- Success criteria: can we add an F1/recall target for the key-entity extraction? Clinicians are sensitive to missed entities. Suggest F1 >= 0.86 and recall >= 0.84.
- Timeline: procurement is tight this quarter; Sanjay (cc'd) will need an MSA + data handling attachment to route to legal. If legal can sign before 6/9 we can still hit a compressed pilot window (~4 weeks).
- On-prem POC: Roberto — are you open to a short on-prem validation for PHI-limited cases? If so, we should note that as an alternate path in the MAP.

Sanjay, can you confirm typical SLA/legal gating and whether we need vendor questionnaires filled out?

Will review the doc and leave comments inline — thanks for pulling this together.

—Amelia
Amelia Johnson
Director, Product (Clinical) | Greenline Health
